title.narrative: Output 3.3 - Improved security sector response to GBV in the Liptako Gourma region.
1. Creation and adoption of training curricula in training institutions. 2. Level of ownership of the findings of the Justice and Security Sector Response Assessment Report by Sector Institutions

target.value: At least 1 training curriculum for professionals in the justice and security sector is developed in each country, and integrated into the training offer 2 80% of the key informants interviewed in the 3 countries consider that the evaluation report has been useful for the development of internal or national initiatives to improve the GBV response.

actual.value:
In Burkina Faso The Association of Women Jurists of Burkina Faso conducted five awareness raising sessions in the first half of 2020 on access to justice for women victims of violence. The AFJ and BF held awareness raising sessions for IDPs on womens rights and violence against women and provided them with legal assistance.
In Mali Training of police Gender Focal Points to develop training curricula for better management of gender based violence for security forces. Recruitment of a gender reference based in Bamako for the 03 countries. In Niger 4 training modules developed: The Niamey ENP and DCAF Gender team developed 4 training modules on sexual harassment at the ENP. These modules are intended for trainers, coaches, administrative staff and students a target of about 1800 people including students, coaches, administrative staff and trainers to fight against sexual harassment at the ENP was launched through a poster campaign

actual.value:
In Burkina Faso the Higher State Control and Anti-Corruption Authority has developed its strategic plan with the methodological support of the programme, some 20 State Controllers were trained in strategic planning.
